caption: "google's birthday" — 1,000,000+ searches in India on September 27, and 200,000+ in the UK.
Why: Google turned 28 on September 27. Its Doodle brought back a logo from its early days, with a birthday trivia quiz.

What most people don't know: Google was incorporated on September 4, 1998, not September 27. It used to celebrate on September 7. The date moved in 2005 and has been September 27 since 2006. Google once explained that it moves "depending on when people feel like having cake."
Very simply put: September 27 is the party. September 4 is the paperwork.

slides.headline: Google turned 28 on Sunday. The paperwork says *September 4*.
slides.sub: 10 things most people don't know about Google's birthday, searched 1,000,000+ times in India on September 27.

slides.headline: Before it was Google, the search engine was called *BackRub*.

slides.headline: Google was incorporated on *September 4, 1998*, in a garage.
